lines.en: label day287:
scene otohafirstday1
With the transfer process once again out of the way, today marks the first day of the rest of Otoha’s life.
I decide to end my train of thought there to leave things on a positive note as I’m sure the rest of her life will be filled with turmoil and anguish.
Such is the life of all of us.
But I guess the fact that I’ve already embellished on why I cut myself off sort of defeats the purpose of cutting myself off in the first place.
Whoops.
But hey, at least now she has the entire[school] year (And every subsequent one for the foreseeable future) to keep doing the things she wants to do.
And her being around is sure to make Rin feel a little better as well.
At least for now.
She doesn’t have the best track record with romance, so there’s always a chance things could go sour at a moment’s notice.
Such is the art of never knowing.
: Are you excited to never learn anything again for the rest of your life?
: I...highly doubt we’ll be in this class for the rest of our lives, Rin.
Ha.
scene otohafirstday2
: I do want to say thanks again for totally-not-stalking me with Nodoka the other day, Sensei.
: If it wasn’t for you guys, I’d probably be spending the morning reading through some boring textbook in my bedroom while my mom makes tea.
: Well the bedroom and the tea parts don’t sound bad. Textbooks are definitely not my thing, though.
scene otohafirstday3
: Sensei, be careful! If you say anything bad about textbooks, Makoto will storm out of the classroom and lecture you about it for the rest of the day.
: Thanks, Rin. I can always count on you to watch my back.
scene otohafirstday4
: Of course. That’s what homies are for, right?
: It’s good knowing that you two are exactly the same inside of[school] as you are outside of it.
scene otohafirstday5
: What's that supposed to mean?
: Not anything weird. I’m already getting used to this guy being overly friendly with [teenager]s.
: I feel like those sentences contradicted each other.
scene otohafirstday6
: Nah. I just mean it’s cool that you’re not really focused on putting up a front or anything like that.
: Like that whole “Serious guy on the inside, not serious guy on the outside” kind of thing.
: I’m pretty sure me revealing that you’ll be getting straight A’s in perpetuity should have said all you needed to know about how I am “on the inside.”
: That part’s still setting in. But yeah, definitely awesome.
scene otohafirstday7
: And don’t worry. The things he makes you do to keep your grades up are only scary the first few times.
: After that, it’s kind of exciting~
: What...sort of things are you talking about?
scene otohafirstday8
: Don’t listen to Rin. I don’t expect anything in return for your grades.
: Though I won’t exactly reject any “donations” you’d be willing to give in exchange for them.
scene otohafirstday9
: Hey! Only I’m allowed to suggest stuff like that! It sounds serious when you do it!
: I’m...good.
: I’ll just...take the grades for nothing since you already promised that was the deal.
: Fair enough.
: Are you settled into the dorms yet or is that happening later?
scene otohafirstday10
: I’m still with my parents for now, but I’ll be moving in with Nodoka by the end of the week.
: It wasn’t as hard to convince them to let me stay outside of the house as soon as I promised I’d be getting straight A’s from now on.
: Ah, so you decided not to switch with Futaba and live with Rin after all?
scene otohafirstday11
: That was an option?!
: I would literally die!
: Platonically, of course! Definitely not because I’m so attracted to her that I would never sleep again!
: Another great save, Rin.
: My nose isn’t bleeding again, is it?
: That happened last week and I really hope it’s not going to be a recurring thing from now on.
: Hahah...hah...
: I just figured it would make more sense to room with Nodoka since, like...I’ve known her longer and...we’re both new here and stuff.
That makes total sense. I’m sure Rin has absolutely nothing to do with that decision at all.
scene otohafirstday12
: That’s fine! I completely understand!
: Besides, you’re going to be right upstairs anyway. So I’m sure we’ll still be hanging out all the time and stuff.
: If you’re not busy, of course. I get that you spend a lot of time practicing and...practice is...yeah.
: You get it.
: I get it.
: Actually, Nodoka and I will probably need some help moving stuff into our room soon if you and Futaba want to give us a hand?
scene otohafirstday13
: You can have more than a hand! You can have my entire body!
: I said that out loud, didn’t I?
: Yup...
: Just a hand is fine for now, Rin.
: Got it!
: I’m gonna go inside the classroom and die now. Later, Otoha!
: Uhh...see you in a couple minutes, Rin.
scene otohafirstday14
: I would once again like to apologize on her behalf.
: She’s just very excited to have you here.
: Yeah...she seems to get excited pretty easily, huh?
: Lately, yeah. She goes through her rough patches, though.
scene otohafirstday15
: She’s told me something like that before. There’s nothing we can do to prevent it, though, right?
: Like, it just kind of happens?
: Probably best to just play it by ear.
: I’m admittedly not great at dealing with things like that. So if you’re also ever going to get all depressed, please give me the proper notice so I don’t make things worse.
scene otohafirstday16
: I’ll do my best.
: I’m normally pretty good at handling stuff like that on my own, though.
: So don’t feel the need to worry about me even though you’re like...my new teacher slash guidance counselor or whatever.
scene otohafirstday17
: Huh? Otoha?
: What are you doing here?
: Oh snap, Io! Are you in this class too?
scene otohafirstday18
: Yup.
: Sensei is awesome. I’m sure you’ll like it here.
: I take it you two are friends?
scene otohafirstday19
: I don’t know if I’d say “friends.” Acquaintances is probably a better term.
: We had a few classes together in our last[school] and Otoha is one of the few people I don’t hate for simply existing.
: Hooray for me.
: I guess your “girls are evil” stance isn’t as strong as I thought it was.
: Otoha is like, barely even a girl.
scene otohafirstday20
: What?
: She was actually super popular with girls in our last[school]. Like, I’m pretty sure more girls have confessed to her than boys.
: I like her. Good pick, Sensei.
: Thanks, Io. Though it was more like Nodoka picked her than me.
: Either way, nice.
scene otohafirstday21
: I’m gonna go sit down and not talk to anyone for the rest of the day now. But it was cool catching up.
: Yeah. See you in class...
scene otohafirstday22
: Hah...
: If it’s any consolation, I definitely view you as a girl.
scene otohafirstday23
: It’s weird cause like, that’s not even the first time I’ve heard that.
: Like...do I come off as boyish to you?
: Not so much boyish, but...maybe just really cool?
: Girls tend to like people they look up to, don’t they?
: I don’t know. I’ve never really liked anyone before.
: How? You’re in [high_school].
: Well yeah, but it’s not like I’ve ever had time for a relationship or anything.
: And even if I did, there’s no way my parents would approve of something like that.
: Well, luckily for you, your parents aren’t in charge of you anymore. And I hereby grant you permission to date anyone you want.
: Thanks. Try not to be too loud though because Nodoka will hear it and start bugging me again.
: I thought you'd be more worried about Rin hearing it.
scene otohafirstday24
: Oh! Would you look at the time? Better go introduce myself to the class before the bell rings!
: Good talk, Sensei!
: Make sure you email my report card to my mom!
scene black
Otoha quickly slides into the classroom, not bothering to hold the door open for me, before taking her place in the front of the room.
scene otohafirstday25
: Ah! The Herald of the Adolescents has the improper armor set equipped!
: Kendo Princess, my defensives are on cooldown! Cast pain suppression!
: Let your pain be suppressed, bro.
: If Wakana can wear a gothic lolita dress to[school], I can go a few days without my blazer on.
: Now pay attention to the obviously female student in the front of the class.
: Uh...hey, everyone. I’m the obviously female Otoha Okakura.
: I’m friends with a few of you already but...for those of you that don’t know me, I’m a musician and a songwriter.
: I’m not great at introductions, so...that’s kind of all I’ve got.
: But if anybody has any questions for some reason, I’d be happy to answer them.
scene otohafirstday26
: Oh my god oh my god oh my god oh my god oh my god oh my god oh my god oh my god.
: Is she...a friend of yours, Rin?
: Yeah. I’ve been trying to get her to transfer in since Christmas. Isn’t she the coolest?
scene otohafirstday27
: She looks...really pretty...
: I didn’t know that...we were allowed to wear pants to[school]...
: I kind of...want to try that...
scene otohafirstday28
: Really? Do you not like skirts, Sana?
: I like dresses, but...skirts make me feel a little exposed...
: But your legs are so nice and smooth and pale and cute.
: Probably. I wouldn’t know because I definitely don’t stare at them while you’re not looking sometimes.
: Well...um...thank you...
: But...maybe I’ll...try something else out soon?...
scene otohafirstday29
: It’s like everyone from my old[school] is slowly taking over this one. I love it.
: Could this give Noriko Nakayama the push she needs to make a run for class president?! Could the scale be tipped in her favor?!
: Find out next week in...Untitled [kumon_mi_high] Drama Show!
scene otohafirstday30
: Oh, um...Noriko, right?
: Noriko! Right!
: What’s up, Chika?
: I’ve been wondering...and it’s probably a stupid question, but like-
: You’re not...related to...Niki in any way, are you?
: I am! She’s my older sister. Are you a fan of hers?
scene otohafirstday31
: Get out.
: But the bell hasn't rung yet.
: There’s no way...
: You’re not messing with me, are you?
: I’m like...a huuuuuuge fan!
: I have posters of her all over my room!
: Really? I’ll have to let her know! She’d be really happy to hear that.
: I could probably introduce you, you know. The new girl at the front of the class right now has already met her a bunch of times.
: Please! Yes! Would she...
: Um, my little sister likes her a lot too. Would it be weird to like...ask her if she could sign something for us?
: Not at all. I’ll ask her the next time I see her.
: Ohhhhh my god...
: This like...completely changes how much I hated you for saying all that stuff about Sensei when you transferred in.
scene otohafirstday32
: Heck yeah! Famous sister comes in handy once again!
scene otohafirstday25
: Oooookay...Well, it looks like no one has any questions, so-
: Excuse me, Miss. I have a question.
scene otohafirstday33
: Nodoka? What’s up?
: It appears that you’ve yet to accept my Facebook invitation regarding the once in a lifetime opportunity I suggested in the park the other day.
Did she actually make a real invitation for that?
I have to say, I appreciate how far she’s willing to take a joke.
: Sensei and I can only prolong this for so many days, so if you’re uninterested, please click the “reject” button as soon as possible so I can-
scene otohafirstday34
: Does anyone have actual questions or is that all?
: I have one!
: Well, I guess it’s not exactly a question but more of just a statement.
scene otohafirstday35
: Oh, yeah. Sure. What’s up?
: And sorry but...what’s your name?
scene otohafirstday36
: Kirin Kanda.
: Like I said, it’s not really a question.
: I just wanted to say that you’re super hot.
: Oh.
: Uhh...well, thanks.
: Any time! Feel free to come hang out with Noriko and me if you’re ever bored.
: I support this! We can get the band back together!
: I will...keep that in mind.
scene otohafirstday37
: And so the battle begins...
: Battle?...
: No...not battle.
: War...
: Rin...you’re scaring me...
scene otohafirstday38
: Okay, well I can see that this isn’t going anywhere. So I just want to say thanks to everyone for accepting me and that...
: I hope we can all get along and stuff.
: And I would like to thank you for having the only proper introduction that we will ever receive.
: Even if there are several of the girls in class who are now either openly or unopenly expressing a desire to hook up with you.
scene otohafirstday39
: Hah...
: It’s going to be another long year, isn't it?...
scene black
